p: thy wondrous works declare: He declares how the faithful will always have opportunity to praise God, as in their need they will feel his power at hand to help them.
When I shall receive the congregation: When I see my time (says God) to help your miseries, I will come and set all things in good order.
of it: Though all things are brought to ruin, yet I can restore and preserve them.
horn on high: The prophet warns the wicked that they would not set themselves against God's people, seeing that God at his time destroys them who rule wickedly.
cup: God's wrath is compared to a cup of strong and delicate wine, with which the wicked are made so drunk that by drinking till they come to the very dregs they are utterly destroyed.
righteous shall be exalted: The godly will better prosper by their innocent simplicity, than the wicked will by all their craft and subtilty.
